_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §GF] (26 Oct) The world gets ready for dawn and dusk. Every routine fires on the local sun's elevation (the place's latitude, §GE.5), never a clock hour; each actor adds a random offset so the change spreads across the twilight. First guesses by Claude (chat); Mike tunes by play.
_help.sun_deg: Sun elevations (degrees) that start and finish the evening change (start > end) and the morning change (start < end). The 18-minute dusk and dawn of §GE sit inside these.
_help.flowers: bloom habits; tagged plants keep their tag, the rest default to always. open_close_s is real seconds for a flower to open or close.
_help.creatures: shift = day | night | twilight. Creatures without a tag default by kind (birds day, bats/owls/moths night, deer twilight).
_help.folk_lights: keepers light their own lights in turn at dusk; per_light_gap_s spreads them; at dawn they put them out, the hearth banked not out.
